title: IGSF10 regulates osteogenesis and osteoclastogenesis via a noncanonical EGFR-STAT1 signaling axis to promote skeletal regeneration.
authors: Wen, Jin; Deng, Yuwei; Jiang, Ruixue; Hu, Longwei; Wu, Qianju; Wang, Xiao; Liao, Zheting; Ding, Wenjing; Jiang, Fei; Chen, Xi; Ma, Xiaohan; Yu, Chunhua; Jiang, Xinquan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IGSF10通过EGFR-STAT1信号轴调控骨形成与骨吸收，属于骨再生生物学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bone remodeling requires precise coordination between osteoblast-mediated bone formation and osteoclast-driven resorption. However, directly targetable and therapeutically actionable mediators that can coordinately modulate both processes during regeneration remain relatively limited. Here, we identify immunoglobulin superfamily member 10 (IGSF10) as a dual-function modulator of bone remodeling. Igsf10-deficient mice exhibit reduced bone mass, elevated osteoclast activity, and impaired osteogenesis. Recombinant IGSF10 protein restores osteogenic capacity and suppresses osteoclastogenesis in knockout cells, while exerting pro-osteogenic and anti-resorptive effects in wild-type mesenchymal and monocyte-derived cultures. Mechanistically, IGSF10 activates a noncanonical EGFR-STAT1 signaling pathway, distinct from BMP2-Smad signaling. Co-immunoprecipitation and molecular docking confirm IGSF10-EGFR interaction, and blockade of EGFR abrogates IGSF10-induced osteogenesis and its inhibitory effects on osteoclastogenesis. In vivo, IGSF10 promotes bone regeneration in both calvarial and periodontal defect models and exhibits synergy with subtherapeutic BMP2. These findings position IGSF10 as a previously unrecognized dual-acting regulator that coordinates bone formation and resorption in a context-dependent manner, with potential therapeutic value for craniofacial and skeletal regeneration.
abstract_zh: 骨重塑需要成骨细胞介导的骨形成与破骨细胞驱动的骨吸收之间的精确协调。然而，在再生过程中能够协调调控这两个过程的直接可靶向且具有治疗可操作性的介质仍然相对有限。在此，我们鉴定出免疫球蛋白超家族成员10（IGSF10）作为骨重塑的双功能调节因子。Igsf10缺陷小鼠表现出骨量减少、破骨细胞活性升高和成骨能力受损。重组IGSF10蛋白可恢复敲除细胞中的成骨能力并抑制破骨细胞生成，同时在野生型间充质和单核细胞来源的培养物中发挥促成骨和抗吸收作用。机制上，IGSF10激活一条非经典EGFR-STAT1信号通路，区别于BMP2-Smad信号。免疫共沉淀和分子对接证实了IGSF10-EGFR相互作用，而EGFR阻断可消除IGSF10诱导的成骨作用及其对破骨细胞生成的抑制效应。在体内，IGSF10在颅骨和牙周缺损模型中促进骨再生，并与亚治疗剂量BMP2表现出协同作用。这些发现将IGSF10定位为一种此前未被识别的双功能调节因子，以情境依赖方式协调骨形成和骨吸收，对颅面和骨骼再生具有潜在治疗价值。
